description:
Two independent Rician fading channel implementations exist, which violates the convention-convergence invariant: one channel model should have one form.

## Background

`gf2_coding::fading::RicianChannel` (`crates/gf2-coding/src/fading.rs`) models block Rician fading with `f64` complex gains for `QpskRicianChannelModel`. `gf2_sim::channels::Rician` (`crates/gf2-sim/src/channels/rician.rs`) models per-symbol Rician fading as an `f32` pipeline stage with a deterministic ChaCha20 word budget. They differ in parameterisation, coherence model, scalar type and RNG contract, and nothing states which is canonical.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One Rician fading model is canonical, with the gain-generation logic in one library location; the other surface either delegates to it or is removed.
- [hard] REQ-02: Block and per-symbol coherence are both expressible through the canonical model, or the remaining difference is a named exception with a tracked convergence condition.
- [hard] REQ-03: Existing seeded outputs of `gf2-sim` fading stages are unchanged, verified by the existing byte-identity suites.
- [hard] REQ-04: Existing `QpskRicianChannelModel` results are unchanged or re-pinned explicitly in the same change, with the reason recorded.
title: Converge the two Rician fading channel models
